text:
ReleaseBot: Deploy started for service=inference-router, build=2026.05.03-1431. Canary=5% in us-west1. Rolling flags: adaptive-routing=true. Notifying oncall.
Maya Chen: seeing a small error blip on the dashboard, 502s up to 0.6% — keeping an eye.
Diego Alvarez: got a PagerDuty page  — grouping by tenant shows spike from tenant:acme-inc and tenant:edu-sandbox.
Sophie Li: pinging release team, any config changes to routing predicates?
Tom O'Neill: yes, adaptive-routing predicate inverted by accident in the canary config (should route=false for legacy models, we flipped it). Rolling back flag now.
Maya Chen: ok execute kill-switch for adaptive-routing on canary and prod? we should stop the new code path.
Tom O'Neill: doing safe kill on canary first, then decide. Command: ```./infra/ffctl toggle --service inference-router --flag adaptive-routing --state off --scope canary```
ReleaseBot: Kill switch applied to canary at commit 7f3a2b. Telemetry: canary error-rate dropping to 0.12% within 30s.
Maya Chen: can we hold canary and not promote? I want to see 5m stable before touching prod.
Diego Alvarez: confirmed: acme-inc error-rate back down, edu-sandbox still elevated but trending down. Might be some cached routes for sticky sessions.
Sophie Li: any customer-impact comms needed? CS reported two support tickets from acme yesterday.
Maya Chen: for now page-level update: incident severity S2. Impact: increased 502s for ~2% of requests for specific tenants, total user-facing errors ~120 requests/min at peak. No data loss.
Tom O'Neill: rerunning cache invalidation for route-sticky keys for affected canary instances. Command: ```kubectl exec router-canary-*/ -c router -- /bin/sh -c 'rm -rf /var/cache/route_*; svcctl reload'```
PagerDuty Bot: Paging Maya Chen (on-call primary) -> acknowledgement required.
Maya Chen: acked. I will be on this for the next 30m and then hand off if stable.
Diego Alvarez: looking at logs, the predicate inversion caused a minority of requests to fall back to an older handler that hasn't had recent latency optimizations -> longer tails and increased upstream 502s.
Sophie Li: notes for postmortem: (1) unit-test for flag semantics (2) add synthesis test in e2e to catch inverted predicates (3) stricter canary gating on tenant distribution.
Tom O'Neill: will open a rollback PR for the flag config and pin the canary to previous value. ref: https://git.redwood.internal/inference-router/PR/5123
ReleaseBot: Canary promotion paused. Automated rollback not triggered.
Maya Chen: handing off at +45m to Diego. Handoff status: canary stabilized to baseline, rollouts paused, kill-switch applied to canary, prod remains unchanged. If error-rate creeps >0.5% or >200 rps errors, escalate to S1.
Diego Alvarez: taking over. I'll monitor the next 2 hours and coordinate with release and cs for customer comms.
Sophie Li: cc @cs-team — prep a short note: affected tenants identified, workarounds are in place, ETA for more details ~1h.
Tom O'Neill: creating an urgent post-deploy checklist item and linking the diagnostic traces. Trace link: https://observability.redwood/internal/trace/abc123
Maya Chen: adding quick remediation diff to the rollback PR to avoid a double-flip during manual fixes.
Diego Alvarez: thanks — will update this thread with any new anomalies. If anything regresses I'll trigger prod kill-switch and page the SRE lead. :thumbsup:
ReleaseBot: Thread marked as incident-track. Logs archived to https://logs.redwood/1729456789.
